behavior: Given two representative opted-in container log entries, the real collector pipeline sends exactly two ingress requests, and each request body is one UTF-8 JSON object with numeric schemaVersion 1 rather than a batch or transport envelope and is accepted by IngestService.ingest(String).
rationale: The one-record-per-request wire shape is observable only across the real collector configuration, capture HTTP endpoint, and serialized ingest seam, so a contract test catches batching and incompatible envelope defects.
